name: cad-backend-stub
description:
STUB ONLY: Forces npm start to launch the Python CAD backend via uvicorn.
This file exists purely so Railway/Railpack's Node.js fallback never emits
`npm: command not found` and never runs an empty/absent npm start script.
The actual backend is Python FastAPI in cad_backend.py.

scripts.build: python -m pip install --upgrade 'pip>=24.1' 'setuptools>=70' 'wheel>=0.43' && python -m pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
scripts.install: echo 'Skipping npm install — this is a Python project.'
